notes.title: ⚔️ Demon Crush Dev Update ⚔️
notes.content:
Hey Demon Hunters!

It’s been a while since our last update—and we’ve been very busy behind the scenes. From level design to new gameplay mechanics, visuals, and UI polish, there’s a lot to share. Here’s a full breakdown of what we’ve been working on.


[hr][/hr]

🧱 Level Design & Grayboxing Progress
We’ve officially started grayboxing the next levels! This means we're laying out the structure of new stages, testing flow, and figuring out how traversal and combat feel in these new environments.


▶️ Partial walkthrough of Level 2:

[previewyoutube="o70532qWRBs;full"][/previewyoutube]

 (Note: Still a work-in-progress—some parts of the cave are not yet hooked up, but you’ll get the vibe.)


[hr][/hr]

🎨 Sprite Work & Character Scenes
New food sprites added (yum!)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/8663226a7a3cee1f87dca6d561d72f07c0ca8ab0.png"]



We're mocking up character checkpoint scenes for Kenzo, Nezumo, and Akana—these will act as spots where you can change loadouts or upgrade skills.   


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/f226a0e748f54dc7248932148dd2b4cbb0bf3414.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/afafa3912cf4cbc92aa7c167f8a7fb64c34c037a.gif"]                           [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/195844ebcca44ee368b756871be4f4277ac3f3ae.gif"]                                      
[hr][/hr]

🎬 Cutscenes Added
We’ve implemented cutscenes into the current demo! These are now playable and help ground the narrative as you move through the story.
[previewyoutube="fh0j_SzzkF8;full"][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

🌆 New Area Mockups
Here’s a sneak peek at some of the new zones we’re planning:

Ruins Area


 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/30d09e64903917b0d1af25ea54e4c351c5432795.gif"]

Castle Dungeon Area 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/6b26d556c9e1a4d0de6cc6f9f1ccd98e9989f6d1.gif"]

Castle Tower 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/a1e13bce45bbfcdb548421701ba324812d403c71.gif"]

Updated Throne Room 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/fc0fb9f7b5584dbf539c2980ce4d7b3e837d9b62.gif"]

Vault Mockup  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/932b7512ec4b7f29f9030eb45cc6575b2b254f64.gif"]

Lost City  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/8c6960fd3087358b5fbcac0a62cc9771fbc2ff37.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/ca93901f3d5cffc6000b70178dbb4ddef6afa292.gif"]

Each area has its own distinct vibe, from eerie dungeons to crumbling temples.
[hr][/hr]

🔧 Testing Environmental Interactions
We’re experimenting with more reactive environments, including:

Crumbling Platform Tiles   

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/0d7ea6057f83e03179bb9e99a0eaa31cc3e09078.gif"]

Shoji Screens
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/379b37508e7558d00378082d399c3187668f9a56.png"] 
[hr][/hr]

🏯 Tower Design Concepts
We’re starting to mock up the tower climb level. Akana begins at the base after Nezumo rides the elevator up—your job is to climb, fight, and reach Mathonas at the summit. The tower is pagoda-style, with red wooden beams, ornate decor, and vertical traversal challenges.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/614130ed15e37e71eb3163deb71e26a4dabf85dd.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]

🧱 Scene Layering Enhancements
We’ve begun layering environmental details—like rubble from broken staircases—to give each scene more depth and visual texture.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/37d77ba29ee3fa82374b32fb51ed5e588ba65f57.png"]
[hr][/hr]

🕹️ Gameplay & System Improvements
Visual Clarity Improvements for Key Scenes
[previewyoutube="bz9-tcYzS3E;full"][/previewyoutube]
We reduced NPCs.

Added a more defined main character outline.

Introduced an arrow indicator to cut down visual clutter and enhance visibility in key scenes.

  

Kenzo Swimming Upgrade

[previewyoutube="BY4q2s-C2eM;full"][/previewyoutube]
Now swims fast and fluidly, with a new animation by @MetalZebra. 

Walls now react better during swim mode. 

Enemies slow down in shallow water, and instantly die if they fall into deep water. 



Loadout Screen Progress
[previewyoutube="71lRutd0A-Y;full"][/previewyoutube]
Weapon selection now functional! 

UI now populates correctly when switching secondary weapons. 

SFX/VFX still in progress.

    

Seal System In Progress

A new system to grant passive perks and modifiers during each run. These are based on Shinto and Buddhist seals with abstract, symbol-based designs—think Hollow Knight charms. Here are some mocks we are considering:
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/6cb8fd2394ac19f13f79f81e338a4361889229d5.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/c0b5bf594387527b48a7e2d667a2f295a8374ba3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/a9078b39e30e27ab50d77f889355a4c9da868057.png"][/carousel]
  

KG Rushdown Move Added 
[previewyoutube="HkgsWJzzi5M;full"][/previewyoutube]
Includes a three-hit, multi-weapon combo with a new “slam” finisher.  
[hr][/hr]

🌐 UI and Accessibility Improvements
The keyboard layout now updates based on the player’s selected language, helping international users get the most intuitive experience. 
[previewyoutube="DwEUJ-Bx-Lk;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]

👀 Missed Our Last Update?
Here’s a quick recap:

Localized into 14 languages:
Arabic, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Portugal & Brazil), Russian, Spanish (Spain & Latin America).
 Watch the Language Support Trailer 

Kenzo’s Fury Demo Launched October 1st 

Available on Steam now! 
[hr][/hr]

🙏 Thank You for Your Support
Thanks for sticking with us while we build out this world. Your encouragement, feedback, and enthusiasm keep us going!


– The Reverting Castles Team 🏰🔥

notes.title: Dev Update: First Demo and Kickstarter Announcement!
notes.content:
Greetings, Demon Crush fans!

We’re thrilled to bring you our very first development update! Since announcing Demon Crush, our team has been working hard to craft an experience that delivers on our love for 16-bit gaming classics like Ninja Gaiden, Shinobi, and Castlevania. Today, we’re excited to share some big news about what’s coming next.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006619/4f67906ef78562c15d3e532fe5bbd5fa7338702d.png

First Public Demo – October 1st
Mark your calendars! On October 1st, we’ll be launching our first public demo on Steam, titled Kenzo’s Fury. This one-level demo will give you a taste of the fast-paced, side-scrolling combat and platforming action that defines Demon Crush. Step into the role of Kenzo Yagimoto, the guardian warrior, as he battles to protect Gochima Village from demonic invaders. Experience fluid combos, super moves, and intense martial arts action inspired by the rich history and landscapes of ancient Japan.

Explore Kohomon Jima, a world drawn from the martial cultures of Okinawa, Iga, and Koga. Not only will you fight your enemies, but you’ll immerse yourself in a world shaped by the warrior’s heart. Kenzo isn’t just fighting for survival—he’s fighting to preserve a legacy.

Kickstarter Launch – October 1st
Alongside the demo, we’re excited to announce that our Kickstarter campaign will also launch on October 1st! Check it out here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/demon-crush/demon-crush-game We’re inviting you to join us on this journey to bring Demon Crush to life. Your support will help us expand the game’s development, with plans to release not only on PC, but also on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox.

By backing the project, you’ll gain access to exclusive rewards and insights into the game’s development, helping shape the future of Demon Crush!

What to Expect

 Fast-paced combat and platforming: Perform air combos, super moves, and unleash your inner martial artist.
 A world inspired by ancient Japan: Stunning 16-bit art combined with modern, kinetic combat.
 Multiple platforms: We’re aiming to bring Demon Crush to PC, Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox.


We’re eager to hear your feedback once the demo drops and can’t wait to share more about the game in the coming weeks.

Thank you for your support, and see you on October 1st for Kenzo's Fury and the Kickstarter launch!

Stay sharp,
The Demon Crush Team
